Sticker on the door reads 'Less Noise, Less Vibration, More Durability'.
Sticker on the right side indicates '10 YEAR MOTOR WARRANTY'.
Significant rust and surface wear on the lower front panel and door frame (photo 0).
The interior drum is visible through the glass door.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and running through a cycle.

risks.risk: The rust on the lower panel may be deep enough to compromise the structural integrity or cause leaks.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rusted area and a video of the machine running to check for leaks.

risks.risk: The door may not close or lock properly.
risks.proof: A video showing the door closing and locking.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty door mechanism

proof_requests: Video of the machine running through a cycle to confirm it powers on and the motor works.
Close-up photo of the rusted area on the lower panel.
Video of the door closing and locking.
Photo of the model number plate, usually found on the back or inside the door.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
